description: This file defines the LocaleLookup class in the Drupal locale module, responsible for caching and retrieving locale translation strings with support for fallbacks and cache management.

classes.name: LocaleLookup
classes.description: A cache collector class for managing locale translation cache with dynamic building, cache key generation, and cache miss resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LocaleLookup object with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: getCid
methods.description: Generates and returns a cache ID based on language, context, and user roles.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Resolves cache misses by finding or creating translations, handling fallbacks, and caching results.
